item.title: Episode 73 - Dr. Amelia Knight Pinkston: 4 Steps to Beating Burnout for Veterinary Professionals - The Whole Veterinarian
item.description: In the veterinary profession, burnout has become a significant issue. Recognizing the signs of burnout and knowing how to recover is critical to sustaining a fulfilling career in veterinary medicine. In a recent podcast episode, renowned integrative health and life coach Dr. Amelia Knight Pinkston shared her journey from a burnt-out vet to a dynamic entrepreneur, offering valuable insights into overcoming professional exhaustion.
